page.overview:
What is Milk Bucket?

A milk bucket and Milk .}} is a drink obtained from a bucket on cows, mooshrooms and goats that can be consumed to clear all effects.

Milk buckets can be obtained from cows, mooshrooms, and goats by pressing while looking at them with an empty bucket.

A milk bucket has a chance of dropping from a wandering trader, if the trader is killed while holding it.

Holding with a milk bucket starts the drinking sound and animation. , the animation is shown only in first-person camera mode.
